changes.detail: Retried the staged release build with command-line JVM memory overrides after stopping the identified failed build processes. No application source or existing history removed.
Prepared APK verification for package/version, release signer, backup settings, local HTTP support and native Wi-Fi screen markers.

summary: The original build exhausted its 512 MB Metaspace limit. A retry now uses 1536 MB Metaspace and a 3 GB heap, preserving compiled outputs.

validation.name: Original Android build
validation.detail: Gradle daemon 29444 reported java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace; no APK produced. Retry log: lecomax-learning-app/artifacts/kali-build7-retry.log.

validation.detail: Two desktop interaction tests including Unicode/Enter/Tab/Esc, six history tests, two access-control unit tests, app/backend typechecks and focused app lint passed. Local desktop API rejects unauthenticated and external-origin calls with 401 and 403.

validation.detail: http://localhost:8081/kali and /change-history returned 200. Initial IPv4 checks failed because the existing server listens on IPv6; an attempted duplicate server exited with EADDRINUSE. No visual verification.
